fields.title: Manager or Senior Manager, Product Design, Admin and Enterprise Platform
fields.summary: Lead product design for Harvey’s Admin and Enterprise Platform, including configuration, governance, knowledge integrations, and the tools legal teams use to understand what AI found. Build and coach the design team.
highlights: 8–10+ years in product design, including 5+ years directly managing designers.
Experience shipping AI-powered or technical B2B products and shaping design strategy with product and engineering.
New York hybrid role; published US$235,500–325,000 annual base salary, with equity and bonus opportunities.
